title: Okta as the identity hub for a multi-org enterprise
description: Okta is the enterprise identity hub. Universal Directory holds every person and AI agent identity, fed by the HR system of record and other personnel data and linked to Active Directory accounts; Identity Governance holds every entitlement. Business units, subsidiaries and regional operations run spoke orgs, on Okta or another identity provider, that connect to the hub over Org2Org and hold their users, groups and local apps. The hub adds staff to partner environments, where external partners sign in with their identity provider or PKI. It authenticates, authorizes and provisions users and AI agents in enterprise systems and provisions edge sites that keep sign-in working when the link drops and sync when it returns

text: Okta creates each person's record from
HR data and links their AD accounts
Spoke admins manage their users and apps
under hub policy, and Org2Org syncs the hub
Okta updates groups, apps and entitlements
when a person changes role, unit or org
Staff and partner users share partner apps,
and partners sign in with their IdP or PKI
Okta removes access in every org and app,
ends sessions and disables AI agents
Edge sites keep sign-in working offline
and sync when the link returns
